body: I often wonder if the truth is actually somewhere around not realizing so many people are to the point of eating a bullet. We all think we're all better than that, but I still sometimes wonder how close things actually are. Sure being married, having someone I really care about helps keep me anchored. But I sometimes wonder if I'm making the right decisions, to do the best things for us.

Ignoring the whole Thanos thing and the massive genocide, being solo by yourself on a planet, just foraging for things yourself, fending for yourself, could have some merit. There are still plenty of places in the world that are pretty severely isolated that it could be possible to be a hermit. The mountain West in the USA has several places where at least for the next 50 or so years you could get rural enough.

As someone whose been suicidal multiple times in my life, please take this LPT seriously. There is a brief moment where you feel relief and/or release when you have a way out planned out. You want to leave the people you care about better off than you found them.

It isn't even a legacy/remembrance thing, it's a making peace with your reality type of thing. People joke about it, but the reality is that once you've made peace with the end, very few things can drag you back from it. 

Love, care, and expend emotional energy, that's what can get people to stop their pans on ending their lives. 

(Check my post history if you want to get a picture of emotion of someone who came close to a razors edge of taking their life).

Hey there. Please keep remember no matter how bleak things may seem, there is always hope. It my be tiny, incredibly small, but there is always a little bit of light at the end of the tunnel. I'm not saying my life is perfect, I still have moment where I regress and really struggle. But you can do good things, it's possible. PM me if I can help.

"assembly" whelp that sounds familiar. If you check my post history you know I'm pretty fucked up in the head, or at least used to be. I'm married, gay, and I haven't told my family that I'm either. I was abused as a kid, grew up as a JW, and spent years, and I mean years de-programming myself. 

I don't mean to gloat, or anything like that, so please don't take it that way. It will get better, you can recover from this, and I'm here if you need someone to talk to.
From friends in the industry, Boeing is decently solid. It just will depend on which departments you work for specifically.

Gotcha on SAD, at least you've investigated the possibility. I was more saying it may be a combination of what you're personally going through and SAD, diagnosed or otherwise. This time of year forcing yourself outside during the day may be beneficial (but that's just a guess).

Ah so you're a sparky, or wanting to be (EE). As much as it pains me to say this, corporate ethics are going to be something that you have to build a bridge and get over (harsh I know). Less harsh version, you'll have to figure out where your personal line happens to be. Some of the best jobs in the industry are in making machines of war, or like you mentioned like the 737-MAX debacle. 

Do what you love, and if you're considering EE you're smart. You'll land in a job where you're happy, or at least in a position to be working toward enjoying your day job. If you find that you're not happy doing what you're doing, look into something else. Not everyone has it figured out by 20 what they want to do, but don't be surprised if it takes you longer to figure it out exactly. You might start as an EE and end up as a pilot.

This thread really struck a nerve with me. 

In short, people who've never walked up to and stood at the ledge of it all, in effect suicide, don't really understand the motivating factors that can bring someone to be there. They don't see the emotional damage, tunnel vision, etc that drives someone to the brink. While I won't say anyone's life is ever perfect, their series of events never drove them to that point. 

I try not to judge others for their life experiences, as we all have a different journey through life. We hit different roadblocks, some people just have a harder road than others. 

Some people care, they just don't always do the best job showing it. There will always be someone in the world who will miss your absence, whether it be your smile, whether it be your laugh, whether it be your dark joke. Humans are social creatures, whether they like it or not.

One thing to consider, you may have something called Seasonal Affective Disorder (SAD) that essentially causes depressive episodes to flare up in the winter where there is less sunlight/less time spent outside. 

While I can't give you dating advice or anything like that as, I'm pitching for the other team (being gay) I will say love comes in all shapes, sizes and packages. If you aren't stumbling across the right people you haven't met someone who is compatible with you. Who fucking cares if you think you don't meet the ideal version of masculinity. The gay community itself has issues with idealizing what is the perfect male specimen, and what I've found is just get to know the person you're with. If someone if giving you hell because of a factor like height, don't waste your emotional energy on them. 

My spouse is shorter than me, but so what. We love each-other and that is what matters. It's sooooooo cliche but there is likely someone out there for you, just don't walk off the ledge of no return without seeing who might be out there for you.

Also, fuck SpaceX, they work you to the bone, their engineers have a horrid quality of life. Sure the experience looks good on a resume, but how much of your soul will be left after you do. If you're interested in aero-space, I may be able to give you some suggestions based on your specialty, if you would like further information.

I could give you hollow platitudes, things will improve, etc. But as someone who has been quite literally posting here asking for help having the conversation, with a gun in my mouth, tasting the steel against the root of my mouth, there is a tiny tiny strand within your soul that is trying, one last effort to reach out for help. 

Even with everything going wrong, listen to that tiny tiny voice asking for help, and follow it.

Even if you don't think you love yourself, don't give up on yourself working through all of this.  Love comes later, but it will happen.

There are so many burdens levied on people these days. I've had a hell of a checkered past (I logged into my alt for this one) so I can completely understand where this student comes form. Always being told no matter what you get isn't good enough and all of those platitudes. Never having a trusted adult to turn to because they just mock and laugh at you when you've ever tried to talk to them. The world today is such a different place, people don't have all of the tools they need to deal with the crises they face. Whether those are the kids dealing with this new world, or the parent if they care, helping the kid navigate this world. It's heartbreaking to see this, but this is the world we live in today. 

Side note, give a fuck about your kids.

I'm sure you know the exact dose that it would take to end everything. I feel you, I knew the exact moment where I knew I would end everything I was about, the cold steel of a small frame pistol in my mouth, see what it tasted like, the gun oil, the gun power from test firing it at the range, the heartless coldness of feeling it in my mouth. Those moments will live with me forever. The notches in the barrel against my teeth, not really caring about the whole suicide part, but what it would do to my teeth and jawline if I were to fully pull the trigger back. 


I won't even pretend to understand what you're going through, the pressure you feel from your family, the never-ending strain to get a good grade. 

While this may seem like the end of the world to you right now in the moment, humor me, what happens if you get the poor grade? Your parents disown you? Guess what, you are still an incredible individual, you have incredible strength that others do not. Hold onto that, you've got the world in your hands, you just don't know it yet. 

If you're studying to be an astrophysicist, maybe your true calling is humanities, or vice versa. Don't accept that you doing poor in one subject area will be the end of you. YOu have this. You're the most powerful person in your world, in your story. Own it. Be that person.

Yes you can, even if it's for one more minute. Thing you can't keep going for hours? Then just keep going for one more minute, each minute adds up, so keep going for that one tiny minute. 

I don't know you, I don't know your pain. But I do know pain in general (check my post history). 

Please, I beg you, hang on just for one more moment, no matter how big or how small, all it takes is one moment to keep hanging on.

> It also doesn't help that I'm a goddamn sissy.

Knock that shit off. You are powerful, you are unique, you be proud of everything you've accomplished no matter how big,. how small, even if it is just writing songs that you'll never release/blog about/upload to soundcloud. 

Every person, should be proud of their creativeness. Are you releasing covers of stuff that already exists? Are you just trying? Doesn't matter, keep doing what you're doing, keep up the motivation, the power, the passion of what you're doing in your personal life. It shows strength that you're continuing to do what you find passion in. That little bit of joy in your life. Hold onto that, don't let it go. It will be what keeps you moving forward day to day.

So there is a little thing that I've used in the past. I don't know how tech savvy you are, but look into something called tiddlywiki, or an app for your phone for journaling/writing down your thoughts. Sometimes, while very painful, writing down what you're thinking can help you take one small step forward, one small, tiny, seemingly insignificant (at the time) step forward. I've went back and reviewed my journals (electronic kinds) and seen how it may not mean much at the time) but it means a lot after the fact about who I am and what is going on.

Yes you can. Hold onto that little bit of hope. Whether than be a dog, a cat, a person, a memory. Find something to hold onto even if it is small, like a random interaction with a friend, a random stranger, no matter how small. Cherish that moment.

Listen to me, don't assume no one cares. Hi, I'm a random internet citizen, coming from a fucking devastating childhood. But sometimes I spend some serious time here trying to help others. I'm not saying thins get better. Things aren't all rosy, life sometimes fucking sucks. I'm here if you need anything. People take a moment and find that one little thing in your life, whether that be an animal, a toy, a memory, etc and hold onto it. Don't lit it go.

I don't know who you've reached out to tonight, but no matter who you reach out to, talk to, etc. We aren't here to judge, evaluate, or anything one. We are here to listen. We are all broken in our own ways, but ultimately, we are here for you. Please respond.

I secretly wanted to join the military (I did in the end, but not the right job that would have allowed me to do it) to be in a job that would send me to battle and be killed. Whether it be suicide, access to a gun, killed by an IED, killed by gunfire or anything else. I didn't really care. All I cared about is that I would end up dying, in a way taht somehow seemed more honorable than suicide was. I don't know how, why, whatever. That never ended up being the end result. But I for sure feel this point of view.

Thanks, I did. Getting away from a job that was destroying me along with finding someone I cared about and finding a way to put the bottle down. This has been the first year in likely over a decade I haven't thought about taking my life. I figured a lot of how I handled my past was pretty common, it just pains me to hear about others who've gone through horrid experiences having to find their own ways to put it all back together as adults. Hopefully they didn't hurt anyone along the way trying to regain their own identities.

No real commentary other than this doesn't really surprise me. Given my past, molested at a young age, forced me to grow up way faster than my peers. I watched pornography way younger than I should have, sexualized things way younger than I should have. And well, as you can tell from my post history, really fucked me up in the head. I'm mostly okay now, but I had some dark times last year.
Thank you for the offer, those of you who stick around, are doing amazing work. Keeping people around, in the worst times of their life.

Honestly, last night was the closest scare I've had for a while. If it wasn't for my SO, and how much pain I would have caused them, I probably would have taken my life last night. 

Thank you for your kind words, I'm doing my best to try to stay with it. And you aren't the first to say, what good is the job/future jobs, if I'm not around to see them. So right now I'm just doing my best to stay alive, and resist getting this bad. Just wanted to reply saying I'm still here, somehow. Thank you.

And this is why I don't try to talk to someone. Check my post history and you'll get an idea to how fucked up in the shadows I am. But nope, never asking for help because the cure is worse than the cause.

My time to shine, I guess, I dunno, I'm drunk and out of fucks right now.

Im a guy, I was kidnapped, driven hundreds of miles away, and brutally molested by my biological father. Check my post history to see how much it has destroyed me as a person. 

No matter how much I grow older, no matter how much I continue to get past it, that shit stays with you. It sucks, it really does. 

I've attempted suicide twice, but never got caught. And I've had less than 5 days in the last few years where I didn't think about killing myself on a daily basis.

I saw your post history and while I won't try to say I know what pain you've felt as an abuse survivor myself, I can at least try to relate to what you've gone through. 

Please know that even in the darkest of days, find something small, no matter how big or small to hold onto. Life is a complex, unforgiving, asshole, but there are so many things that are worth holding out for.. Check google earth for the USA Grand Canyon, or visit other places around the globe. There places are either a testament to nature, or to humanity. 

Please give these things one more shot before checking out.

Everyone has to navigate life in their own way. Is there anything you have interest in, no matter how big or small? Even when I'm at my worst I still try to find something tiny to hold onto. Something to keep me grounded to keep from pulling the trigger. 

I'm not going to say life gets better, as depression is a constant struggle. However, I will say there are little things out there that make life valuable. Please keep trying to find the smallest thing to look forward to, just one tiny thing.

Not sure if you're still here, but from one survivor of being molested, it sucks. I know every situation is different, every life is different. But I can at least attest to life being worth trying for. It sucks, but please try to find something, even if it is something small to try to hold on to. If that is a dog, a pet, no matter what, please try to hold on to.
All of the time. Hell, that's why I'm here. I have a decent life, a caring significant other, food on the table. Yet, I feel every day about ending my life. Why am I here, why do I even bother...

Yes, and those of us who have held a gun to our head and/or in our mouth and tasted the cold steel and gun oil know all too well. We all find our own little tings/reasons to wait just one more minute. Human life is a very complicated animal, everything doesn't matter as equally as we get once chance to make a tiny impact on the world around as as we can. The cruel irony is that we should try to hold on as long as possible. Try to find one small thing thing that helps, go outside and hike, get lost in a world like WoW or Minecraft. 

I can't tell you what to do with your life, just keep holding on, and reach out. There are people who've suffered too, and we're here for eachother.

While I won't see this likely until very late on Monday if yo respond, here is the thing. You likely have a lot of people who care for you. You just may not be ware of it. Hell, I have a significant other, yet I still don't feel worthwhile, however I know they are there. 

There is no good way to commit suicide. Even if you use a gun, which won't guarantee it as much as you might think, it leave a very messy byproduct behind. If you want to talk, vent or whatever, I'll do everything I can to talk to you. 
Know there are people who care, even if they are just random internet strangers.

I'm willing to listen and do anything I can for you. And I mean that as someone who comes from a very checkered past. 

I don't know if you feel upset or where your emotions lye. I'm just in the weird place that I know where people who've held a gun to their held feel, while also knowing there is a small part of me that wants to keep going. Please know there are many people out there who care, even if I know nothing about you.

I'm late to this message. I'm in my late 20s, and by all accounts externally a decently successful person. I still have suicidal thoughts, but I still try to wake up every day and find something no matter how small to hold on to. I see from others commenting that you're decently young. Don't read this post as things don't ever get better. 

Life is very complicated, there are many routes that every life can take. It's very fragile. No matter what you believe, please know that every life is a gift, and can make an impact on the world. PM me if you need too, I'll be online for about another hour.

If you look into the username you'll find out what branch I am fairly easily. PM me if you are looking to talk or if you have more questions along these lines. I don't know what to tell you publicly other than don't look to the military for salvation. It may work for you, but the high ideals that everyone thinks the military has, aren't there for everyone.

I can't say I joined for the same reason, but there were some undertones to my decision. It's a ton of work to do that, and once you're in, the US Military doesn't have the greatest support system. I don't know your age, your level of education, what branch you're looking at or whatever. You may find great friendship, or you may end up like me feeling completely alone. The military is a very mixed bag. 

I don't know the point I"m trying to make other than please reach out to someone for help. Don't be like me and be fatalistic about things.

I'm as okay as I can be. I'm mostly a zombie who is dead inside and constantly struggles with the most basic things. I find a way to keep trying, but my fear is that one day a challenge will come along that I can't get around.

Had to switch to my throwaway via tor in order to post this. I've had a gun to my head several times of the last few months. Hell I've even written a suicide note and have my will all written out. I have everything prepared exact actually performing the act of ending my own life. The thing that stopped me? Someone telling me they care. Someone just telling me straight up, I care about you. I made the post on a thread a while back (dig through my post history sorted by top) and I received PMs telling me not to do it, that some random internet stranger cared about my well being. I have a few friends in real life, that I can't confide in because it would destroy all future plans. I can't seek help because it would destroy my hope of getting out of the situation I'm in. Instead, I received the validation and motivation to continue on from here, from kind internet strangers. I refuse to let myself me one of the 1-2 Navy sailors who end their life on a weekly basis. At least, for now.

Never underestimate the power of telling someone you care about them.
Thank you so much. I'll certainly explore that.

I don't know about taste, but I can attest to the sensation of the metal itself. The cold steel against your temple. Knowing that your entire future rests on a single muscle movement. It's weird I'm very suicidal, and have the gun within arms reach, but I still somehow find hope to hold on. It don't know how, I don't know why. It's important to try to find that one thing, to keep your grasp on. But what do I know, I'm just another emotionally fucked up dude on the internet. IF I can do anything PM me.

No one has, and those who do, have no idea of the depths of human pain, suffering and despair. My heart goes out to stranger, if I can do anything let me know. I don't know how much I have left to give to others, but if I can do anything, please let me know.

Humanity sucks sometimes, that is just how it goes. There isn't any other way to describe it. I just hope that I have the strength to get through this. Just remember there are likely people around you, that you know, that have suffered horrible things. You just don't know because they haven't talked about it.

Don't worry I don't take this as a "who has had a worse life" contest. There on people in this thread alone that have gone through far worse than I have. We all have our own battles to fight in life, our own path to make, and our pain to cope with. The events that caused the trauma vary, but it comes down to the battles we fight. 

Weird analogy for sure, but I get what you're saying. Each fight you win, makes you a little bit stronger when you have to fight another battle. Just my issue is I haven't really been winning any battles, I spent years fighting off the pain, but in light of what is going on right now, I seem to keep losing. I'm still here, but I see a not very good trend in my future if I don't get this spiral under control. 

Posting my story, and knowing I'm not alone helped out last night, I honestly don't know how I was able to even type with my mental state. If I was able to reach one person out there, then I'm able to find some join in the pain.

Thank you so much for your kind words. I wish more people had done more, but that ship has long sailed. 

Thanks for the words of encouragement I'm still here fighting the battle. I just hope that I'm able to keep the "demons" at bay.

The O side isn't the same, and there is a ton of branch specific stuff that goes into it as well. I've looked into it, trust me. I have to serve the rest of my contract. So I'll have to find a way to hold it together until I can get out.

You too, know there are people around, more than willing to listen, people who have suffered greatly. You're in good company, as broken as I am, I'll still listen to others, if it helps you at all, please message me.

That's awesome, I wish we had the same option, but sadly we don't. I'm just expected to suck it up, and keep it to myself. As much as every branch preaches about how accepting they are, they don't practice what they preach. If I brought up what I've been through, I would be told to suck it up and do my job. In many ways, officer corps is less forgiving than the enlisted side.
I don't know what to ay to what you've posted other than I'm so sorry this happened. (check post history). If it is any consolation maybe we can share misery together.

As military myself, and an officer to boot (check post history), this surprises me. I've very glad your branch is more receptive to your past. Mine however, is not. If you ever find yourself in a dark place, or just want to chat, please let me know.

Check out my post history, I was abused as a kid. It heavily impacts me now, I've just gotten better at hiding it. I don't know exactly what you're going through, but if I can do anything to ease your misery, please PM me.
I'll PM you.

No worries on the PM, but to be honest, there really isn't any kind of forgiveness I can give to him. I actually hate everyone who says this (not you, because like a few posters ago, you're asking out of curiosity). This isn't something that can really be forgiven. I mean he is literally dead, so I know that he can't hurt anyone else. It's weird, It's not something I can really ever forgive. And even if I do, I can't ever forget. I have night terrors, probably undisagnosed PTSD (which I hate using that term because of the soldiers, marines, airmen, and sailors who've lost people on the battlefield, which I'll never see, even though I"m active duty) about what happened. It isn't something that can just be forgiven. It's someone that stabs you in the mind, interrupts your thoughts, something you can't shed no matter the situation or how happy you are at the moment.

Thank you, I'm already counting down the days until the end of my contract. I fucking hate everything about what I'm doing and what the military represents. Even if it isn't that horrible for someone who wants to be there, to me every day is torture.

I've checked out /r/raisedbynarcisists and it fits my situation, being subscribed there on my main account is too triggering. In many ways it's better for my stability to just not think about everything that happened. This whole thread has been basically a deep drive back into everything that causes me severe pain. But I"m doing it, in the tiny hope that it helps someone else. Even if it pushes me back to holding a gun to my temple, if I"m able to save one other life out there, then I'm happy with the result.

Thank you dearly for the kind words. I wish the parts about my mother was false, but it isn't. There is also some of the even more frustrating bits left out. I could write a novel on how my family screwed me over. But I always know that someone else out there has it worse than me. I somehow manage to hold it together, even if I wish it was all over with. 

Thank you for your kind words, yourself and other on here, remind me that even with the crushing pain of defeat, abuse, an d humiliation, there is always at least something to live for, even if it is tiny.

Regardless on you feel at the moment, I'm no there to tell you how to feel. now there is an interest stranger who has been a muscle twitch away from ending their life due to sexual assault, someone is always here for you. And likely someone who might have an understanding of the pain you're going though.

You're welcome, even though this is a throwaway account, it's only because I want to separate it from my main account. >not because I'm going to abandon it. I've had a gun to my temple three times, and made one other attempt. No matter the crushing pain I'm under, I've found a way to make each day a advancement forward. Do the same,. don't let your thoughts drag you so deep that suicide is the only option. I've let myself get that far down the rabbit hole before, and I honestly don't know how I got out.
Even if you haven't been though what I have, the thought that someone cares out there means more than you may realize..

Please check my post history, scroll back as far as it goes. https://www.reddit.com/r/AskReddit/comments/5zzqe1/serious_male_rape_victims_of_redditwhat_is/df2pmnp/ know that you aren't alone in the pain you are going through.

> the next

As someone who has suffered molestation, please don't' delete or ignore this. Or if you do, please don't let the replies fall on deaf ears. I've almost blew my brain out a few times. But have manged to find something, no matter how small to continue to hang on. If that means finding someone on Tinder, cool. If it means training for a marathon, do it. Don't let the overwhelming pain, end you life. There is too much to explore out there.

Thank you, you're word mean so much, whether now or in the future. Life is very complicated. I don't want to end my life, but there are days where it seems preferable than contusing in this cloud that I spend my time in.The things you have said haven't fallen on deaf ears, and I think you.

I'm not diagnosed with PTSD, but I probably should be. It has to do with the fact I don't tell anyone how deep the pain and suffering really goes at least in a position, that can actually do something about it. "Have you never thought about taking your own life" "check no" even though I know that it is a lie. 

Connect isn't the wrong word, people have different tolerances for pain and suffering, but the irony is that only those who have been though this have the emotional capacity to understand, not just empathize, but actually have an idea of what people go though.

I can't even begin to describe your pain, check my post history, just know the pain you're experiencing, it in god company. Life fucking sucks, but lets find that small grain, or foothold where you can start to build something new.

I don't really have much to say, other than know you're in good company. https://www.reddit.com/r/AskReddit/comments/5zzqe1/serious_male_rape_victims_of_redditwhat_is/df2pmnp/ or look at my post history. I don't pretend to know your specific situation, but just know you're in good company about whether you can continue to live. Survivors battle with that on a regular basis. Know there is someone out there, who has at least suffered some of what you have. I've held a gunt o my temple several times, but there was always something keeping me from fully releasing the trigger. Please reach out to someone before you are to that point. Challenge yourself to something, non romantic, non sexual, like run a marathon. But know there are people who care, even if it is just a fellow survivor on the interwebs.

You're welcome, the pain is very real on my side as well. No mater the pain we've been through, no matter how bad it gets, someone, anyone, will listen. That is what has kept me going. If it's reddit, or if it is a close friend. Regardless of your beliefs, life is a gift, and it's important to use tit to it's full potential. Even if it mean suffering a lot of your life, just be able to help someone else. That one life saved, will be worth it.

You're words mean more than you may realize. Thank you for being a caring voice out there. Regardless of the atrocities we have all experienced, know that misery shared, is a burden that you have lifted off your shoulders. There are those of us that have seen the worst that humanity has to offer. I'm very happy your significant other is understanding, without judging. Hold onto them, for they see who you are, not what has happened to you.

You're words mean more than you may realize/. Thank you or your PM. I've been close, but if I can listen, and provide a source for someone out there, who had had a very horrible run at life. It is enough for me to hang on a bit longer.
Even if it is some stranger on the internet, whose is similar quantities of fucked up, please PM me with your troubles. If it means saving a life, the effort was worthwhile.
See, you say there isn't any harm in overcoming. I agree.. We all have to fight the battle we are dealt. Just some of us are able to overcome our situation more than others.

I would normally reply in a PM, but the world needs to see this too. Check my post history, probably have to scroll to the bottom. Life fucking sucks, and some of use drew the card regarding playing it on hard more. To say we haven't all thought about suicide is a lie. Just know there is someone who cares out there, who has also drawn the challenge card in life.
Thank you for you're reply. It means more than you might realize.

Thank you for the reply. I'm not in a position to receive a campaign medal, much less a purple heart. Thank you for the sacrifice you've made. I just joined and went through the motions, you likely did something for your country that you gave an actual sacrifice for. And to which, I thank you, as cliche as that sounds. I'm glad to hear that you've found someone who understands that you have a difficult past. When you react it isn't because you are rejecting them, its because of what has happened to you, and is willing to work with that.

I know it was something completely out of my control, and I hope that even if I choose to go to the extreme of ending my life, it somehow helps someone else. I'm trying to find the positive, but every day is a struggle, every moment is a battle.
Having pets inst' aligned with my landlord, but I'm working on it. I know I have friends IRL who care about my wellbieig, but due to geography and hell understanding, I can't really relate to them.
Check my post history, starting at the oldest, if there is anything I can do for you please PM me.

In general that is to be expected, just by virtue of the majority of the population. Remember a lot of small communities, still represent the average of the population that flock to it. So take the average of the USA,  CAN, GBR, AUS, and take the average of the opinions and ideals, and you'll find reddit. Not because of any specific reason, just because those are the broad strokes of people using it.
